ai.overview: UConn brings the College Basketball Belt to Tucson for a November showdown with Arizona on November 18, 2026. The Huskies have defended the belt once in this reign and enter 3-0 on the season, while Arizona sits at 2-1 and has held the belt 15 times previously in the championship's history.
key_matchups: UConn's recent dominant form, including an 83-41 win over Wagner and an 86-46 rout of Gardner-Webb, against Arizona's mixed results
Arizona won the most recent meeting 71-67 in 2025 and leads the all-time series 5-3
The Wildcats are 2-1 after losses to UCLA and Michigan in the playoffs, while UConn is riding a 3-game winning streak
ai.betting_angles: UConn has won three straight with impressive margins, including the 83-41 victory over Wagner, but the Elo model favors Arizona at home. The head-to-head history leans Arizona's way at 5-3, including a 71-67 win in their last meeting in 2025. Both teams showed they can score in bunches early this season, with Arizona posting 104 against Cal Poly and UConn hitting 86 against Gardner-Webb.
ai.prediction_writeup: Arizona gets the nod at home despite UConn's strong 3-0 start. The Wildcats own a 5-3 all-time edge and won the most recent meeting 71-67 in 2025. UConn has been impressive with wins like the 83-41 rout of Wagner, but the Elo model backing Arizona at home carries weight. Arizona's 15 previous belt reigns suggest they understand what it takes to win these championship games. The Wildcats' home court and recent head-to-head success should be enough to claim the belt.
